purpose: Determine whether V48's common-domain extreme-density failure is already present in its train-only Gaussian-mixture likelihood through rare PIT overdispersion, unsupported component mass, or excessive but finite analytic physical moments, versus being introduced only by the empirical conditional-rank copula.

audit_population.model: unchanged V48 EMA checkpoint in evaluation mode

exact_native_voxel_diagnostics.scope: every 64^3 native train voxel in every frozen train object
metrics: mean NLL within empirical standardized-target upper q99 and q99.9 subsets
PIT lower and upper observed-over-expected ratios through probability 1e-5
mean mixture weights and posterior truth responsibilities by component
upper q99 and q99.9 posterior truth responsibilities
exact Gaussian-mixture analytic E[rho], E[rho^2], and E[(rho-1)^2] averaged over native train conditions
empirical train E[(rho-1)^2] on the same native voxels
per-component contribution fractions to analytic E[rho^2] and E[(rho-1)^2]
exact_native_voxel_diagnostics.physical_definition: y=backbone+target_mean+target_std*z, rho=10**(4.5*y), delta=rho-1; for Gaussian z~N(mu,sigma^2), E[exp(t*z)]=exp(t*mu+0.5*t^2*sigma^2)
exact_native_voxel_diagnostics.moment_evaluation: float64 analytic evaluation without clipping, scale caps, Monte Carlo, or posthoc DC correction

fixed_probe_posterior_predictive.probe_indices: reuse the V46 seed 146046 and exactly 4096 independently sampled native voxels without replacement per train object
fixed_probe_posterior_predictive.uniform_seeds: 146049 plus member, 10000000 times domain index, and 10000 times object index
fixed_probe_posterior_predictive.inverse: unchanged V48 28-step Gaussian-mixture inverse with rank epsilon 1e-7
comparisons: standardized residual posterior-predictive versus probed train truth
log10rho posterior-predictive versus probed train truth
sampled mean delta squared versus probed train truth
analytic probed mean delta squared versus probed train truth

fixed_branches.condition: any domain has a component with mean weight at least 0.02, posterior responsibility divided by weight below 0.5, and at least 0.5 of the analytic rho-squared contribution

every domain overpredicts posterior-predictive q99.999 log10rho by more than 0.10 dex or analytic mean delta squared by more than 1.5, while upper PIT observed-over-expected at 1e-5 is below 0.5 in at least two domains
any domain has global effective posterior-responsibility component count below 3.0
all domains pass lower and upper PIT 1e-5 ratios in [0.5,2] and posterior-predictive q99.999 within 0.10 dex, but any domain has analytic mean delta squared outside [2/3,1.5]
every domain passes lower and upper PIT 1e-5 ratios in [0.5,2], posterior-predictive q99.999 within 0.10 dex, and analytic mean delta squared ratio in [2/3,1.5]

hard_checks: clean committed worktree and exact V48 record, program, checkpoint, report, cache, preflight, and decision hashes
Lageunha Ada GPU and exact V48 parameter count
all train object, native voxel, and fixed probe counts exactly match this program
all model parameters, NLL, PIT, responsibilities, finite Gaussian moments, sampled values, and reported ratios are finite
mixture weights and posterior responsibilities sum to one within 1e-5
no validation data, development arrays, Astrid, or historical EAGLE access
